intro.title: Document translation built for business
paras: BeTranslated focuses on B2B document translation. We work with small and medium-size businesses, large corporations and international organisations.
Our network of professional translators covers almost any business document, in any industry. Each project goes to the linguist whose specialist knowledge fits it best.
checks: We work mainly for businesses and organisations, not individuals
Freelance professionals who translate only into their native language
A flexible, efficient service that adapts to your requirements

image.alt: Folders and binders of documents stacked on a shelf

what.title: Documents we translate
what.lead: From a single page to a full manual, we handle the paperwork behind your business.

items.title: Everyday communication
items.text: Internal and external memos, emails and letters.

items.title: Plans and studies
items.text: Business plans, marketing plans and feasibility studies.

items.title: Finance and reporting
items.text: Shareholder reports, loan applications, purchase orders and invoices.

items.title: Presentations
items.text: Conference decks and investor presentations, formatting included.

items.title: White papers and summaries
items.text: White papers and executive summaries that read as if written locally.

items.title: CVs and HR files
items.text: CVs and staff documents for international hiring.

what.note: Whatever the format, send it as it is. Tell us in the request form if you need the translation returned in a particular layout.

items.title: Flexibility
items.text: Freelancers in several time zones let us work around the clock. We keep to your deadline without lowering the quality.

items.title: Professionalism
items.text: Experienced translators with specialist knowledge, chosen through a rigorous selection process and supported by translation tools.

items.title: Responsiveness
items.text: You receive confirmation straight away and a personal reply within 8 working hours.

items.title: References
items.text: Years of financial, legal and business documents for companies large and small. Meet some of them on our customers page.

quote.title: Send us your documents
quote.lead: Tell us what you need and attach your files. We reply with a free, no-obligation quote within 8 working hours.
quote.checkTitle: What to include in your request
checks: What the translation is for and where it will be used.
The languages you need, from and into.
Every page of the document, or the approximate number of pages or words.
The date you need it by.
Any layout or file format you want the translation returned in.
quote.note: With these details we can reply with price and turnaround within a maximum of 8 working hours.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Do you translate documents for individuals?
We predominantly work for businesses and commercial organisations.
If you are unsure whether we can help, send us a message and we will tell you.
Which file formats can you work with?
We handle all common formats, from PDF to Excel, as well as Word documents and presentations.
Send the file as it is and we confirm how we will return it.
A freelance professional with expert knowledge of both languages and of your subject area.
Our translators only translate into their native language.
Which languages do you translate into?
We regularly translate documents into global languages such as French, German, Russian and Portuguese.
Tell us your combination and we confirm availability.
How quickly will I receive a quote?
You get confirmation of receipt straight away.
A more personal reply follows within 8 working hours.
Once we agree the terms and you send back a signed order form, your translators begin immediately.
